params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Accelerando:}} {{ci|Sona}} gains a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy champion with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}''. If she has max stacks, she instead {{sti|cdr|reduces}} the cooldown of ''{{ai|Crescendo|Sona}}'' each time.
params.blurb2: [[File:Sona Power Chord 3.gif|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Innate - Melody:}} '''Sona's''' {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}} incur a {{sti|cd|brief}} cooldown on her other basic abilities, and cause her to generate a unique {{tip|aura}} for a short time that empowers herself and nearby allied champions.
params.blurb3: [[File:Sona Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Innate - Power Chord:}} '''Sona's''' basic abilities generate permanent stacks of ''Power Chord''. At 3 stacks, her next basic attack consumes them all to become empowered with bonus magic damage and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability cast.
params.blurb4: [[File:Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Accelerando:}} For each stack, '''Sona''' gains {{sti|ah|basic ability haste}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate - Accelerando:}} '''Sona''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'', stacking up to 120 times. At maximum stacks, she instead reduces the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} of ''{{ai|Crescendo|Sona}}'' by {{fd|1.5}} seconds each time.

[[File:Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Accelerando:}} For each stack, '''Sona''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} basic ability haste}}}}, up to {{as|60|ah}} at maximum stacks.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Melody:}} Whenever '''Sona''' casts a {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, her other basic abilities incur a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} global cooldown and she generates a unique {{tip|aura}} for 3 seconds that empowers herself and nearby allied champions. Only one aura can be active at a time.
params.description3:
{{sbc|Innate - Power Chord:}} '''Sona's''' basic abilities generate a stack of ''Power Chord'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, her next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> is empowered to consume them all to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|{{pp|20 to 80 for 7;90 + (240-90)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=10 + 10 per level until level 8, then + 15 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast:
* ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Staccato:}} '''Bonus''' damage is modified to {{as|{{pp|20*1.5 to 80*1.5 for 7;90*1.5 + (240*1.5-90*1.5)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=15 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 22.5 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.
* ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Diminuendo:}} Reduces the target's {{tip|size}} by 8% and damage dealt by 25% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 3 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Song of Celerity|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Tempo:}} {{tip|Slows}} the target by 50% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
params.description4: ''Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sona's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* ''Power Chord'' stacks are represented by a counter under '''Sona's''' [[health bar]], visible to the player only. It will light up when the empowered effect is available.
** When ''Power Chord'' is ready, '''Sona''' gains a ring around her. This ring will have a different color depending on the last ability used (''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona|blue}}, {{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona|green}} or {{ai|Song of Celerity|Sona|purple}}'').
** The effect does not change if abilities are used while the projectile is in motion.
* The triggering attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.
* '''Sona''' retains ''Power Chord's'' stacks when entering {{tip|resurrection}}.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|wards}} and [[jungle plants]].

blurb.plain: Innate - Accelerando: Sona gains a permanent stack of Accelerando each time she hits an enemy champion with Hymn of Valor and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with Aria of Perseverance. If she has max stacks, she instead reduces the cooldown of Crescendo each time.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Melody: Sona's basic abilities incur a brief cooldown on her other basic abilities, and cause her to generate a unique aura for a short time that empowers herself and nearby allied champions.

blurb3.plain: Innate - Power Chord: Sona's basic abilities generate permanent stacks of Power Chord. At 3 stacks, her next basic attack consumes them all to become empowered with bonus magic damage and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability cast.

blurb4.plain: Accelerando: For each stack, Sona gains basic ability haste.

description.plain:
Innate - Accelerando: Sona generates a stack of Accelerando each time she hits an enemy champion with Hymn of Valor and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with Aria of Perseverance, stacking up to 120 times. At maximum stacks, she instead reduces the current cooldown of Crescendo by 1.5 seconds each time. 
 Accelerando: For each stack, Sona gains 0.5 basic ability haste, up to 60 at maximum stacks.

description2.plain: Innate - Melody: Whenever Sona casts a basic ability, her other basic abilities incur a 0.5-second global cooldown and she generates a unique aura for 3 seconds that empowers herself and nearby allied champions. Only one aura can be active at a time.

description3.plain:
Innate - Power Chord: Sona's basic abilities generate a stack of Power Chord, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, her next basic attack is empowered to consume them all to have an uncancellable windup, deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast:
* Hymn of Valor - Staccato: Bonus damage is modified to ⟦pp⟧ (+ 30% AP).
* Aria of Perseverance - Diminuendo: Reduces the target's size by 8% and damage dealt by 25% (+ 4% per 100 AP) for 3 seconds.
* Song of Celerity - Tempo: Slows the target by 50% (+ 4% per 100 AP) for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.

description4.plain: Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack resets Sona's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sona}} projects sound bolts to the two nearest enemies that each deal {{as|magic damage}}, and she gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that damages an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.blurb2: [[File:Sona Hymn of Valor 2.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within a few seconds.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Power Chord}} – Staccato:}} ''Power Chord'' deals {{as|'''increased''' magic damage}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' sends out bolts of sound to the two nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, prioritizing champions. Each bolt deals {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area around the target for 1 second.

'''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|825|Sound bolts search range}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|400|Aura radius, center-to-edge}}}}
params.notes:
* The bolts deal {{tip|area damage}} while the attacks, while the {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}}}} empowered attacks deal {{tip|proc damage}}.
* Sight of the targets' area is granted on-cast.
* The {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}}}} empowerment given to tagged allies respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against [[ward]]s.
